title: Matibag: P7B flood projects in Duterte district went to 1 contractor

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag revealed on Thursday that the bureau discovered that P7 billion worth of flood-control projects in the district of Davao City Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte were awarded to a single contractor. “The figure we are looking at was a bit low: It was P1.9 billion in projects awarded to a contractor; it was actually P7 billion from 2018 to 2024,” Matibag said in an interview on Thursday. Matibag cited records from the Commission on Audit (COA). READ: DPWH Davao region chief called over flood works probe Matibag earlier said Genesis88 Construction […]...
